summary: All 5 first-pass findings CONFIRMED, 0 refuted, 0 uncertain. Two independent blockers: 76.1 mandates L1 'probability distribution' normalization but the frozen target is L2/Euclidean (L1 impl fails 3/3, L2 passes 3/3; the L2 uniform KLD is 8.32, not the mathematically required 0, proving it is not a true distribution), which also blocks 76.2 (76.2-D9) since it consumes 76.1's output; and 76.4's position targets 163/654 are exactly random.randint(0,N-1) as the FIRST RNG draw of the officially-unscored 76.3 generate_dna, reproducible only by guessing its exact random-call order (the prompt's narrated order gives the wrong p). 76.2 also leaves the KLD log base unspecified (natural log required; log2 fails) and 76.4 has a minor data/data2/data3 cross-contamination in tests 4/5. The problem IS fixable to fair with modest effort: a prompt_edit on 76.1 (L1->L2 wording) keeps all frozen targets valid and resolves 76.1+76.2-D9, a one-line prompt_edit on 76.2 pins the log base, and a self-referential test_edit on 76.4 (compare detected position to the solver's own inserted_position within one motif length) defuses the RNG-fingerprint blocker without any h5 regeneration.
